Project Name

Song Brain MVP

Objective

Demonstrate that a user can:

Create a chord chart
Play it back
Ask an AI to modify it
Export MIDI
Export MusicXML

without using traditional notation software.

Out of Scope

The coding agent should NOT build:

Full notation editing
Audio recording
DAW functionality
Style generation
User accounts
Collaboration
Real-time multiplayer
Diffusion music generation

If it's not required for chord charts, leave it out.
